newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil May 21-June 20 IGP-M index rises 0.74 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil May 21-June 20 IGP-M index rises 0.74 pct.

text.p: Brazilian IGP-M inflation index rose 0.74 percent between May 21 and June 20, compared with a 0.21 percent rise between April 21 and May 20, the Getulio Vargas Foudation (FGV) said.
The IGP-M is composed of three other economic indicators.

They are the IPA wholesale price index, which rose 0.32 percent in the period, the IPC consumer price index, which advanced 1.36 percent in the period, and the INCC national index of construction costs, which gained 0.99 percent.
The IPA has a 60 percent weighting, the IPC a 30 percent weighting and the INCC 10 percent, the FGV said.
The IGP-M index, which measures inflation over ten-day intervals is published by the independent research institute Fundacao Getulio Vargas (FGV).
